item.title: Chinese APT Hackers Target Global Banks to Steal Financial Intelligence and Spy on Microsoft 365 Accounts
item.dc:creator: Tushar Subhra Dutta
item.description:
Chinese state-linked hacking groups are going after banks around the world, and their goal is intelligence rather than cash. item.title: Hackers Impersonate Microsoft Exchange Online Alerts to Trick Users During Microsoft 365 Outage
item.dc:creator: Tushar Subhra Dutta
item.description:
Hackers used a real Microsoft 365 outage to send fake Exchange Online alerts claiming that four emails were being held and would be deleted unless recipients restored them. The messages borrowed a genuine Microsoft incident number and sent users through several redirects to a page that looked like Microsoft’s sign-in screen. The outage was real; […]

item.title: CISA Warns of Puppet Enterprise Vulnerability Actively Exploited in Attacks
item.dc:creator: Guru Baran
item.description:
The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has warned that attackers are exploiting a critical vulnerability in Perforce Puppet Enterprise. The agency added CVE-2026-115731 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog on November 17, 2026, citing evidence of active exploitation. item.title: Chrome 158 Fixes 204 Vulnerabilities, Including Critical Code Execution Flaws
